questions.q: What does the book suggest you do to gain permission for courage?
questions.why: The first lesson is to accept permission to pursue what you want.

questions.q: Which psychologist is quoted about not shutting down emotion?
questions.why: Dr. Brene Brown says you can't selectively shut down emotion.

questions.q: What does the book say habits do to emotions?
a: Trigger a routine that gives a reward
questions.why: Habits trigger routines that reward emotions, especially fear.

questions.q: How does the author recommend handling limiting stories?
questions.why: Reframing limiting stories turns them into success catalysts.

questions.q: Who is the client example used to illustrate limiting stories?
questions.why: The book mentions a client named Carolyn as an example.
